"Baat Ban Jaye" Video Song | A Gentleman- Sundar, Susheel, Risky | Sidharth | Jacqueline | "Latest Hindi Songs"
Watch Gaurav and Kavya groove to the beach party song of the year! Baat Ban Jaye is a fun, groovy track shot in some of the most exotic and beautiful locations in Miami. Catch Sidharth Malhotra and Jacqueline Fernandez displays some sizzling chemistry while they party on this beach song.
